newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Woo Sung Food, Honam Food shares halted.
newsitem.headline: Woo Sung Food, Honam Food shares halted.

text.p: Trading in shares of South Korea's Woo Sung Food Co Ltd and Honam Food Co Ltd was halted on Friday on news that the companies were selling parts of their operations, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
Woo Sung'a shares last traded at 25,900 won, up 1,900 on the day, and Honam's stock was 1,500 won higher at 27,500.
The exchange said trading would resume on Saturday.

Woo Sung will sell its beverage business operation to Coca-Cola Korea Bottling Co Ltd for about 110 billion won on April 1. The company decided to sell the business in order to rationalise management, the exchange statement said.
Honam Food decided to sell its beverage operation to Coca-Cola for about 48.5 billion won after its concentrate supply contract expired.
Meanwhile, U.S.-based Coca-Cola Co said it would invest more than $400 million in South Korea over the next five years to finance a new bottling system.
